meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把 NanoClaw agent 组改成用本地 Ollama 模型，而不是 Anthropic API。它需要你提供 agent 组名称、模型名称，并能选择屏蔽 Anthropic API 以防意外扣费。
howto.when: 当你想本地运行 agent、节省 API 费用或尝试开放权重模型时，可以要求 Claude 执行此操作。

say.text: 帮我把默认 agent 组切换到本地 Ollama 的 gemma4 模型
say.note: Claude 会询问确认并自动配置容器和设置

say.text: 我想用本地模型跑 agent，请配置 Ollama 并屏蔽 Anthropic
say.note: Claude 会要求你选择 agent 组和模型

howto.what_en: Claude will reconfigure a NanoClaw agent group to use a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. It asks for the group name, model name, and optionally blocks the Anthropic API to prevent accidental charges.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user wants to run an agent locally, reduce API costs, or experiment with open-weight models.

say_en.text: Switch my default agent group to the local Ollama model gemma4
say_en.note: Claude will confirm and auto-configure container and settings

say_en.text: Set up Ollama for my agent group and block Anthropic API
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to choose the group and model
